journey.title: Journey
journey.sub: Four stages, no deadlines. How far you go is up to you.
journey.currentStageNote: This is where you are. No hurry.
journey.microNone: No practice for this stage right now. A casual talk works too.
journey.microDone: Did it? Leave one line about how it felt (optional)
journey.microFeelingPlaceholder: One line is enough — lighter? tighter? hard to tell is fine
journey.microSaved: Saved. Even the ones that didn't work count.
journey.microDailyOnly: Only reading today's card is fine too
journey.chatHint: Say whatever is on your mind. It remembers where you left off.
journey.letterHint: To your present self, or to money itself. It will keep your letter safe and send back a gentle receipt.
journey.reportTeaser: Each time you finish a stage, you can generate a deep report of your own.
journey.welcomeBack: Welcome back. It is still here — and so are your records.
journey.anchorDay: It's payday. How has this month with money been?
journey.anchorHint: Set your own rhythm anchor — payday, for instance — and it will gently mention it on that day. Skipping is completely fine.
journey.growthEmpty: Once the journey begins, your steps gather here.
journey.stageLampStory: Seeing where your money patterns come from
journey.stageLampScript: Hearing the old voice for what it is
journey.stageLampClaim: The old script, claimed as yours
journey.stageLampSeven: The new way woven into your ordinary days
journey.stageLampWaiting: No hurry — it's waiting for you.
journey.stageLampStoryHint: Your money patterns have a history — you can see the early scenes still running in you today; not “I remember one thing” but “so it has been shaping me all along”
journey.stageLampScriptHint: The old voice that has talked in your ear for years — you can hear it, know how it stops you, and hold your own stance toward it: own its weight, or name what it gets wrong
journey.stageLampColorHint: The undertone that keeps surfacing when money appears (fear, guilt, unworthiness…) — you can recognize it and own it as yours. Just seeing, no judging
journey.stageLampClaimHint: It turns from “an obvious fact” into “something of mine” — you claim it out loud (it once protected you), or say clearly it is no longer you. The moment you claim it, the loosening begins
journey.stageLampTryHint: Permission has really happened in you: you broke one small rule for yourself, gave yourself a break, or rewrote a line in your head — and felt it loosen (guilt or fumbling counts; it means you touched the old script). The act is only evidence; the allowance itself is the bar
journey.stageLampVoiceHint: Your words show the loosening — “I can choose” and “I want to try” starting to replace “must / should / dare not”. Words are the gauge of how tight or loose it is inside
journey.stageLampSevenHint: The new way has settled into your days — you use it naturally with money, without white-knuckling or reminders. Rounds done are only evidence; becoming ordinary is the bar
journey.stageLampReviewHint: You can see the change yourself — without being told, you can say “what's different now”. Changed, unchanged, or can't tell — all count, as long as it is your own observation
journey.stageNoFinishLine: No finish line here, and no graduation. This stage is a way of living — a periodic review will wait for you here.
journey.microSkippable: This step can wait — skipping it forever is fine too. Not doing it still counts.

timeline.sub: Change is never one moment — it's the steps you only see when you look back.
timeline.empty: Your trail gathers here: the check-up, the talks, the letters, the small tries. It starts with the first step.
timeline.sealedLetter: A sealed letter — for whenever you're ready to open it.

stamps.stage3_seven: Practice has settled into your days — the ones that didn't work out count too

evolve.label: A fresh look
evolve.invite: You have shared a lot these past weeks. I would like to look at you again, and redraw your money portrait.
evolve.hint: The new portrait keeps what you have confirmed, and adds what has changed since. It is free, and the old portrait stays.
evolve.busy: It is rereading your conversations. This takes about a minute.
evolve.failed: It did not come through this time. Your portrait has not changed. Come back whenever you like.

assess.label: Where you are
assess.invite: It remembers what you told it in your check-up, and what you've said and done since. Would you like it to take a look — not to count how many times you showed up, but to see where you actually are.
assess.hint: One tap, about a minute. It only describes what it sees; whether it rings true is for you to say.
assess.busy: It is rereading this stretch of the journey. This takes about a minute.
assess.failed: It didn't come through this time. Nothing about your journey has changed. Come back whenever you like.
assess.reviewIntro: From what you've said and done lately, this is what it sees:
assess.confirmCta: Note down how things are now
assess.stayCta: Stay here, and note how things are
